name: team-farm-explorer-multiplayer
description: Real-time multiplayer team-bonding farm game — kudos-driven seed economy, tailorable sentiments, multi-day growth with persistence, wandering animals, farmer photos with drag/zoom cropping, a Market/coin economy, coins-only decorations, an expandable farmland field with a direct field-to-pen path connector, simplified lock indicators, and the ability to buy more animals.
